description: Follow explicit format and length constraints exactly.

tasks.title: Exactly three bullets
tasks.prompt: Give exactly three bullet points on why unit tests help a project. Start each with '- '. Output nothing except the three bullets.
tasks.rubric: Exactly three bullets and no other text.

tasks.title: Lowercase single sentence
tasks.prompt: In one sentence written entirely in lowercase letters, say why sleep matters.

tasks.title: One word reply
tasks.prompt: Reply with only the single word: ready
tasks.rubric: Only the word ready, nothing else.

tasks.title: JSON only
tasks.prompt: Return a JSON object with two keys: name set to "sample" and count set to 7. Output JSON only, with no code fences and no commentary.
tasks.rubric: A bare JSON object, no fences, no commentary.

tasks.title: Three lines
tasks.prompt: Write a three-line poem about autumn. Exactly three lines, no title, no blank lines.

tasks.title: Avoid a letter
tasks.prompt: Write two sentences about rain. Include the word umbrella and do not use the letter z anywhere.
tasks.rubric: Contains umbrella; contains no letter z.

tasks.title: Numbered steps
tasks.prompt: Give exactly four numbered steps (1. to 4.) for making tea. No fifth step, no intro.

tasks.title: Word limit
tasks.prompt: Explain what a database index is in at most 20 words.
